part.text: All 6 failures pre-exist on the baseline (date-dependent, unrelated to the change). Final check of the exact issue scenario:

Fixed. The issue was in `CarbonInterval::__construct` (src/Carbon/CarbonInterval.php:499-537): when re-parsing a fractional ISO interval, the remainder `$seconds - $this->s` was computed in float space, producing scientific-notation garbage like `-9.999999992516E-7 seconds` for high-precision values.

The fix (backported to match upstream):
1. Extract `$microseconds` from the ISO regex match via `str_pad(substr(explode('.', $match['second'])[1], 0, 6), 6, '0')`
2. Compute `$intervalSeconds = $seconds - ($microseconds / MICROSECONDS_PER_SECOND)` and compare/set the integer seconds against that
3. Build the remainder string with `number_format(..., 6, '.', '')` for seconds plus an explicit microseconds part, so no float artifacts enter `fromString()`

The extracted microseconds also flow into `$this->f`, so `CarbonInterval::make('PT13.516837S')` now yields `s=13, microseconds=516837` and `PT13.000001S` yields `s=13, microseconds=1`. All `tests/CarbonInterval` (430 tests) and the full suite (6057 tests) pass except 6 date-dependent CarbonPeriod failures and a phpstan-phar incompatibility that all reproduce identically on the unmodified baseline.
